summary: Global UX Cleanup testing complete. All InlineAutocomplete fields working correctly for Certifications, License Type, Position/Title, and Department/Unit. Keyboard navigation (ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Enter) works. Custom text entry works. Profile save works. Minor UX note: exact matches don't show dropdown (by design).

issues: Typing exact state code (e.g., 'CA') doesn't show dropdown because InlineAutocomplete filters out exact matches. User must type partial (e.g., 'C') to see suggestions. This is by design but may confuse users.
